A space-only italic nested inside an otherwise empty strong wrapper still separates the words on either side

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><i> </i></strong>Beta</p>')
puts result.content.inspect
```
